dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Day 16 Results**

The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1 behind the strong effort of their staff. Abimelec Ortiz led the offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Will Dion earned the win after 5 strong innings. On the other side, the Reds' Brady Singer took the loss.

In a thrilling 4-3 win, the Athletics edged out the Boston Red Sox. Eli White led the way with a 3-hit performance, while Elvis Alvarado earned the save after a strong outing from Brayan Bello.

The New York Mets routed the Pittsburgh Pirates 11-1, with Luis Robert Jr. hitting a home run and driving in 4 runs. Sean Manaea dominated on the mound, striking out 11 over 7 innings.

In a back-and-forth game, the Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the Toronto Blue Jays 7-6. Kyle Schwarber hit 2 home runs and drove in 4 runs, while Jesús Luzardo pitched 7 strong innings.

The Atlanta Braves edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, with Trent Grisham hitting a home run and Cam Schlittler dominating on the mound.

The Miami Marlins crushed the Los Angeles Angels 12-3, with Griffin Conine hitting 2 home runs and driving in 3 runs. Grayson Rodriguez started strong but took the loss.

The Chicago Cubs defeated the Kansas City Royals 10-2, with Miguel Amaya hitting a home run and driving in 3 runs.

The Chicago White Sox outlasted the Cleveland Guardians 5-3, with Colson Montgomery hitting a home run and driving in 3 runs.

The Milwaukee Brewers edged out the Minnesota Twins 4-3, with Jake Bauers hitting a home run and driving in 2 runs.

The St. Louis Cardinals defeated the Colorado Rockies 7-4, with Hunter Goodman hitting a home run and driving in 2 runs.

The Baltimore Orioles defeated the Texas Rangers 10-5, with Pete Alonso hitting 2 home runs and driving in 4 runs.

The Detroit Tigers edged out the San Francisco Giants 3-1, with Drew Gilbert driving in a run.

The Arizona Diamondbacks defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 4-2, with Ketel Marte hitting a home run and driving in 2 runs.

The Tampa Bay Rays defeated the Seattle Mariners 4-1, with Yandy Díaz leading the way with a 4-hit performance.

The San Diego Padres crushed the Houston Astros 7-2, with Fernando Tatis Jr. hitting a home run and driving in 3 runs.
